summary: Stamped runtime version (2026.8.1) kept in root.go at the base tree's anchor position; the generated version.go omits its duplicate 0.0.0-dev declaration.
reason: Press 4.31.x moved 'var version' from root.go into a new version.go, resetting it to 0.0.0-dev. The library's release-ledger guard rejects PRs whose diff touches runtime-version lines alongside normal files; keeping the stamped var byte-identical at the base position keeps version lines out of the diff so post-merge automation retains ownership of stamping.
validated_outcome: git diff --unified=0 upstream/main...HEAD -- internal/cli/root.go and version.go contain zero lines matching 'var version ='; binary reports 2026.8.1.
